reason: Test incorrectly asserted that only :sub positions should have exit_handlers cleared. In paper mode, ALL positions must have handlers cleared because precompute_strategy_signals() creates new TokenSignals each tick. Handlers (RSIExitHandler, MeanTargetHandler, SMATrailExitHandler) hold sig refs and index into arrays by local_bar, which would cause IndexError with stale sig refs. The implementation correctly clears all positions, matching the original code design.
fix: Renamed to test_all_positions_handlers_cleared_not_just_sub and asserted both regular and :sub handlers are cleared
